arxiv-2207-13468.title: Some QCH Kähler surfaces with zero scalar curvature.
arxiv-2207-13468.creator: Włodzimierz Jelonek
arxiv-2207-13468.description:
A 2022 arXiv research paper by Włodzimierz Jelonek. In this paper we prove that some well-known Kähler surfaces with zero scalar curvature are QCH Kähler. We prove that the family of generalized Taub-NUT Kähler surfaces parameterized by k ∈ [ − 1 , 1 ] k\in[-1,1] is of orthotoric type for k ∈ ( − 1 , 1 ) k\in(-1,1) and of Calabi type for k ∈ { − 1 , 1 } k\in\{-1,1\} and the Burns metric is of Calabi type. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification

arxiv-2510-18149.title: Conformal Inference for Missing Data under Multiple Robust Learning
arxiv-2510-18149.creator: Wenlu Tang, Hongni Wang, Xingcai Zhou, Bei Jiang, Linglong Kong, and Economics, Nanjing Audit University
arxiv-2510-18149.description: Abstract We develope a novel approach to tackle the common but challenging problem of conformal inference for missing data in machine learning, focusing on ’Missing at Random’ (MAR) data. Our method, inspired by the innovative Multiple Robust (MR) framework, introduces a general approach to construct prediction intervals, which employs various candidate imputation and propensity score models.

arxiv-2511-18135.title: Evaluating Parametric Car-Following Models in Naturalistic Congestion: Insights in Driver Behavior and Model Limitations
arxiv-2511-18135.creator: Huaidian Hou*, Corresponding Author houhd@umich.edu Arpan Kusari, Ph.D. kusari@umich.edu Brian T. W. Lin, Ph.D. btwlin@umich.edu
arxiv-2511-18135.description: Abstract \AuthorHeaders Hou, Kusari, and Lin \TotalWords 6509 1 Abstract Car-Following is a broadly studied state of driving, and many modeling approaches through various heuristics and engineering methods have been proposed. Congestion is a common traffic phenomenon also widely investigated, both from macroscopic and microscopic perspectives. Yet, current literature lack a unified evaluation of Car-Following models with naturalistic congestion data.

arxiv-2602-02971.title: Nonlinear electrohydrodynamics of a surfactant-laden leaky dielectric drop
arxiv-2602-02971.creator: Michael A. McDougall 1, Stephen K. Wilson 2,1, Debasish Das 1
arxiv-2602-02971.description: Abstract A nonlinear three-dimensional small-deformation theory is presented for a leaky dielectric drop coated with a dilute monolayer of insoluble apolar surfactant and subjected to a uniform DC electric field. The theory is developed within the framework of the Taylor–Melcher leaky dielectric model, and builds on previous work by retaining surface charge convection in the charge conservation equation.

pmc-10644535.title: Survival of cervical cancer patients at Moi teaching and Referral Hospital, Eldoret in western Kenya
pmc-10644535.creator: E. Mwaliko, P. Itsura, A. Keter, Dirk De Bacquer, N. Buziba, H. Bastiaens, A. Jackie, A. Obala, V. Naanyu, P. Gichangi, M. Temmerman
pmc-10644535.description: BackgroundCervical cancer is a major health burden and the second most common cancer after breast cancer among women in Kenya. Worldwide cervical cancer constitutes 3.1% of all cancer cases. Mortality rates are greatest among the low-income countries because of lack of awareness, screening and early-detection programs and adequate treatment facilities.

pmc-10696662.title: Diagnostic efficacy and safety of radial probe endobronchial ultrasound-guided transbronchial needle aspiration for adjacent lesions in segmental or subsegmental bronchi: a single-center retrospective study
pmc-10696662.creator: Debin Ma, Junli Zhang, Qingwei Zeng, Baining Li, Meili Gong, Zhiyuan Zhang, Zhuang Ma
pmc-10696662.description: BackgroundPeripheral lung lesions can be sampled using various techniques, including computer tomography-guided transthoracic needle aspiration, electromagnetic navigation bronchoscopy, virtual navigation bronchoscopy, and radial probe endobronchial ultrasound transbronchial lung biopsy. Mediastinal lesions can be sampled using techniques like convex probe endobronchial ultrasound-guided transbronchial needle aspiration (CEBUS-TBNA) and endoscopic ultrasound-fine-needle aspiration.

pmc-10745760.creator: Tianci Wang, Zikun Jia, Canghai An, Ping Ren, Yiting Yang, Wanting Wang, Ling Su
pmc-10745760.description: This study’s objective was to examine the protective effect and mechanism of a novel polysaccharide (AYP) from Auricularia cornea var. Li. on alcoholic liver disease in mice. AYP was extracted from the fruiting bodies of Auricularia cornea var. Li. by enzymatic extraction and purified by DEAE-52 and Sephacryl S-400.

pmc-11387653.title: Ultra-high freshwater production in multistage solar membrane distillation via waste heat injection to condenser
pmc-11387653.creator: Primož Poredoš, Jintong Gao, He Shan, Jie Yu, Zhao Shao, Zhenyuan Xu, Ruzhu Wang
pmc-11387653.description: Passive solar membrane distillation (MD) is an emerging technology to alleviate water scarcity. Recently, its performance has been enhanced by multistage design, though the gains are marginal due to constrained temperature and vapor pressure gradients across the device. This makes condenser cooling enhancement a questionable choice.

pmc-11481122.title: ABO blood types and head and neck cancer: a systematic review with meta-analysis of observational studies
pmc-11481122.creator: Hanbo Shi, Jingjing Yao, Chenchen Jiang, Wenying Xu, Zhongliang Jiang, Yan Chen, Yun Qian
pmc-11481122.description: ObjectivesThis research aims to explore the correlation between ABO blood groups and neoplasms in the head and neck region, specifically investigating the susceptibility of different blood groups to tumours.DesignSystematic review and meta-analysis.Data sourcesCNKI, WANFANG DATA, PubMed, Web of Science and Embase databases were systematically searched from inception to January 2024.

pmc-11605425.title: Riboflavin kinase binds and activates inducible nitric oxide synthase to reprogram macrophage polarization
pmc-11605425.creator: Xiao Shan, Zemin Ji, Baochen Wang, Yanan Zhang, Hongyuan Dong, Weijia Jing, Yanzhao Zhou, Penghui Hu, Yan Cui, Zihan Li, Sujun Yu, Jinxue Zhou, Ting Wang, Long Shen, Yuping Liu, Qiujing Yu
pmc-11605425.description: Riboflavin kinase (RFK) is essential in riboflavin metabolism, converting riboflavin to flavin mononucleotide (FMN), which is further processed to flavin adenine dinucleotide (FAD). While RFK enhances macrophage phagocytosis of Listeria monocytogenes, its role in macrophage polarization is not well understood. Our study reveals that RFK deficiency impairs M(IFN-γ) and promotes M(IL-4) polarization, both in vitro and in vivo.

pmc-12471416.title: Glutamine and Albumin Levels in Cerebrospinal Fluid Are Correlated with Neurological Severity in an Experimental Model of Acute Hepatic Encephalopathy
pmc-12471416.creator: Pedro Arend Guazzelli, Felipe dos Santos Fachim, Anderson Santos Travassos, Caroline Casagrande Schaukoski, Pâmela Cristina Lukasewicz Ferreira, Fernanda Uruth Fontella, Marco Antônio de Bastiani, Adriano Martimbianco de Assis, Diogo Onofre Souza
pmc-12471416.description: Background/Objectives: Hepatic encephalopathy (HE) is a severe neurological complication of acute liver failure (ALF) characterized by the accumulation of neurotoxic metabolites and impaired cerebral function. We aimed to examine the correlation between HE severity and cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) biomarker levels in a rat model of ALF induced by subtotal hepatectomy.

pmc-12594326.title: On campus dormitories as viral transmission sinks: Phylodynamic insights into student housing networks during the COVID-19 pandemic
pmc-12594326.creator: Juan Bolanos, Alex Dornburg, April Harris, Samuel Kunkleman, Jannatul Ferdous, William Taylor, Jessica Schlueter, Cynthia Gibas
pmc-12594326.description: University student housing environments are often viewed as hotspots for infectious disease transmission due to their high-density living conditions and high frequency of interpersonal interactions. During the COVID-19 pandemic, concerns arose that on campus dormitories could serve as amplifiers of viral spread, seeding outbreaks into surrounding off campus student residences.

pmc-12610697.title: Lightweight Reinforcement Learning for Priority-Aware Spectrum Management in Vehicular IoT Networks
pmc-12610697.creator: Adeel Iqbal, Ali Nauman, Tahir Khurshaid
pmc-12610697.description: The Vehicular Internet of Things (V-IoT) has emerged as a cornerstone of next-generation intelligent transportation systems (ITSs), enabling applications ranging from safety-critical collision avoidance and cooperative awareness to infotainment and fleet management. These heterogeneous services impose stringent quality-of-service (QoS) demands for latency, reliability, and fairness while competing for limited and dynamically varying spectrum resources.

pmc-12648652.title: Combining AlphaFold with Focused Virtual Library Design in the Development of Novel CCR2 and CCR5 Antagonists
pmc-12648652.creator: Khaled Essa, Kian Noorman van der Dussen, Yao Yao, Bente Bleijs, Natalia V. Ortiz Zacarias, Laura H. Heitman, Gerard J.P. van Westen, Willem Jespers, Daan van der Es, Martin Šícho
pmc-12648652.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). CC chemokine receptor (CCR) 2 and 5 are G protein-coupled receptors that play a crucial role in immunohomeostasis. Accordingly, overactivation of their signaling pathways is involved in various immunopathologies and cancer. Extensive research focusing on discovering CCR2 and CCR5 orthosteric antagonists, ultimately resulted in some clinical success, but the area of intracellular allosteric modulators is still underexplored and the move from orthosteric to allosteric modulation could be an interesting paradigm shift.

pmc-12649040.title: A WeChat mini-program-based intervention for orofacial myofunctional therapy in adults with obstructive sleep apnea–hypopnea syndrome: a randomized controlled trial protocol
pmc-12649040.creator: Yuqing Ren, Ning Ding, Mao Mao, Xinxue Qi, Ye Zhu, Mei Su, Zhifei Yin, Xiao Lu
pmc-12649040.description: BackgroundOrofacial myofunctional therapy (OMT) has been recommended as a safe, effective, and low-cost option for treatment of obstructive sleep apnea–hypopnea syndrome (OSAHS). This study aims to evaluate the therapeutic effects of a WeChat mini-program-based OMT in adults with OSAHS compared to traditional home-based OMT.

pmc-13081230.title: Evidence of West Nile virus exposure in healthy donors and a clinical case in an immunocompromised child: emerging public health implications
pmc-13081230.creator: Ashwaq M. Al-Nazawi, Rana Alghamdi, Ali A. Al-Zahrani, Wafa Ali Hetany, Maseer Khan
pmc-13081230.description: BackgroundWest Nile virus (WNV), an emerging mosquito-borne flavivirus, is a growing global concern, particularly in tropical regions, where climatic conditions favor vector proliferation. Although often asymptomatic, less than 1% of cases develop severe neuroinvasive disease, primarily among the elderly or immunocompromised. Transfusion-transmitted WNV infections have been documented but remain underrecognized in the Middle East.

pmc-13262161.title: Physicochemical and structural properties of myofibrillar proteins in abalone (Haliotis discus hannai): Effects of pulsed electric fields
pmc-13262161.creator: Zhao-Ming Lin, Hai-Hong Wu, Jia-Yin Huang, Kang Liu, Min-Jie Cao, Duanquan Lin, Le-Chang Sun
pmc-13262161.description: This study explored how pulsed electric field (PEF) treatment at voltages of 10 − 30 kV affects the properties of abalone myofibrillar protein (MP). As voltage increased, compared with control, solubility, fragmentation index, carbonyl content of MP, and ozone content in solution kept rising, while Ca2+-/Mg2+-ATPase activities decreased.

pmc-13290717.title: Global research trends and hotspots in human immunodeficiency virus-associated cervical cancer (1990–2025): a multi-database bibliometric analysis
pmc-13290717.creator: Lin Sui, Rutie Yin

pmc-13352969.title: Clinical recognition of pediatric diphtheria in a resource-limited Somali hospital: a prospective observational study
pmc-13352969.creator: Farah Ali Ahmed, Mohamed Nur Ali, Mohamed Yaqub Hassan, Mustafa Gahnug, Yasir Khalif Ali, Farah Abdullahi Ismail, Ali Abdi Jama, Abdullahi Mohamed Hassan Fujeyra, Mohamed Mukhtar Mohamed, Said Abdirahman Ahmed
pmc-13352969.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundDiphtheria remains a life-threatening disease in low-resource settings where immunization coverage is poor and access to a laboratory is limited. Somalia is currently experiencing a resurgence of clinically suspected diphtheria among children, yet detailed case-level clinical data remain scarce. The purpose of this study was to illustrate clinical features, vaccination status, complications, and early outcomes of pediatric diphtheria in a resource-limited Somali hospital.

pmc-13617680.title: Nurse counselors’ experiences of recruitment and retention of female sex workers in a HIV vaccine trial: a qualitative study from urban Tanzania
pmc-13617680.creator: Masunga K Iseselo, Edith A M Tarimo, Joel S Ambikile, Gift G Lukumay, Patricia Munseri, Mohamed Bakari, Eligius Lyamuya, Said Aboud, the PrEPVacc Trial Team
pmc-13617680.description: BackgroundNurse counselors play a pivotal role in recruiting and facilitating the retention of volunteers in HIV vaccine trials. They act as the primary interface between the research team and volunteers, typically tasked with educating, supporting, and guiding participants through the trial process, including adherence to the study protocol for care and safety.
